walkthrough: Goal: see my practice at a glance, what I did each day and how far I have come, without the app counting the hours it lay open while I did something else, and without days in a row to keep.

Before any practice: on the home the Practice column offers Start (the first lesson) and, at its foot, All units and Practice book. Practice book opens the book: Home at the top left, Practice book in the middle, at the right quietly 0 lessons · 0 min. Below, October as a calendar, Monday first, the 5th ringed: today. Nothing else: nothing done yet. Home goes back.

Monday 5 October: a lesson of Lines at level 1. I copy the first line and compare it, a few minutes at it, Next to the sixth, then Finish. The lesson's end at the right: Lines, 6 exercises and the time, a dot for each, the skill's dots, a vermilion seal stamping down, FIRST STEP (初练 in Chinese). Home.

Tuesday 6 October (I left the app overnight): a lesson of Colours at level 1. I pick and fill the first colour after two minutes, compare three minutes later; then I put the tablet down with the app open for two hours. Back, Next to the second colour: I fill it after two minutes, compare a minute later, and go home, the lesson under way.

The book: at the right 1 lesson · 13 min or so. The calendar: the 5th and the 6th each a wash behind its number, the 6th ringed (today). Beside it the colour's first pick as a point with its ΔE × 100 over it, lesson 1's first line with its original in thin see-through red, the FIRST STEP seal. The 6th tapped: its card, a few minutes (the two hours count nothing). The 5th: Lesson 1 · Lines; tapped, its sheet opens, done, its end at the right.
Wednesday 7 October: Start continues the colours lesson at Colours 2/3. Next to the third; I fill it, leave the app half an hour (it counts nothing), come back, compare, and Finish.

The book: three days washed, each by its time, 2 lessons; a swipe to the right across the calendar shows September (empty); Later month brings October back. The 7th tapped shows Lesson 2 · Colours (painted over two days, it shows on both) with its colour pairs. The back button goes home.

Not here: a colour copy painted over two days and a record from before 1.7.0 timed by its compares (the practice crate's and the store's tests); the 100 lines and 100 colours, ten-session and stage seals (the seals' tests).
